L=np.log

def model(p):
    a,b,d,e=p[4],p[5],p[6],p[7]
    cols=[P*L(P), L(P)*L(1+a*t), L(1+P)*L(1+b*t), L(1+P)**2*L(1+d*t)**2]
    B=np.c_[cols].T
    return B
def resid(p):
    B=model(p)
    with np.errstate(all='ignore'):
        c=np.linalg.lstsq(B.T,y,rcond=None)[0]
        r=B.T@c-y
    return np.where(np.isfinite(r),r,1e3)
